description: Read an item's tags. Returns the tags attached to one item. The item is addressed by kind (`entityType`) plus its handle, so the same call reads tags off a queue item, a flag, a config, a kill switch, a metric, a tracked error, an alert rule, or an experiment.

entityId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

entityType.description: The kind of item a tag set hangs off: `ops` (any queue item — bug, feature request, error/alert/measure-plan ticket), `flag` (feature gate), `config` (dynamic config), `killswitch`, `metric`, `error` (tracked error group), `alert_rule`, or `experiment`.

name: tags_get
